Subject: Success charter draft + 30-day close window (GDoc & checklist)

James —

Quick note to share an initial mutual success charter (attached GDoc link) and a proposed 30-day close window so we can align expectations and lock the pilot timeline. The doc focuses on:
- Key stakeholders & approvals (who signs what and when)
- Success criteria & 4-week eval scope (performance, latency, feature fit)
- Deliverables & owner calendar (demos, data handoff, security review)
- Procurement & legal milestones (PO, signed agreement)

Ask: can you review the charter and mark any missing owners or dates by Friday 10/17? I included a short checklist at the bottom for procurement steps so your team can confirm.

Notable constraints: we recommend a 30-day trial window to validate latency and cost at expected QPS; if procurement needs more time we can stagger start of traffic while preserving the pilot scope.

GDoc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2b3C-redwood-success-charter
Attachment: novaforge-trial-sla-appendix.pdf (attachment stub)

Thanks —
Priya Natarajan
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

--

From: James Sullivan <j.sullivan@novaforge.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@novaforge.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Oct 2025 10:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Success charter draft + 30-day close window (GDoc & checklist)

Priya —

Thanks for the draft — this is helpful. A few quick notes inline, plus high-level questions below:

1) Stakeholders: please add our ML infra lead (Sana Mirza) as a technical owner — she owns the on-prem networking requirements.
2) Procurement: our finance folks typically need two weeks to review vendor terms; is there a shortened SOW we can sign to start integration work while legal finishes the PO?
3) Success criteria: can we include a short perf target (p95 latency < 220ms for 1K concurrent users) so our QA can script load tests?

I made comments directly in the GDoc. Procurement looped in but they asked for a clean PDF of SLAs and the redlined commercial terms.

Would it be possible to propose a staggered start (integration week + 30-day pilot) to keep momentum?

Best,
James
Director, Product — Novaforge
j.sullivan@novaforge.com

Priya / Aditya —

Quick updates after a brief sync with Legal and the runtime team:

- SOW addendum: Legal can produce a one-page integration addendum that limits scope to "non-production integration" and caps liability; I can have a DocuSign-ready version by COB Friday (10/17).
- Perf target: Aditya confirmed that 220ms p95 at 1K simulated concurrent users is achievable on a standard dedicated config with medium batching and int8 quantization on our 8xA100 SKU. He noted that if Novaforge expects sustained 1K QPS, we'd recommend a 2x config for headroom during peak tests.
- Procurement deliverables: I'll export the SLA appendix as a clean PDF and include an itemized commercial summary for their finance team.

Next steps (to close in 30 days):
1) Priya: send DocuSign addendum and PDF SLA to James + procurement (target: 10/17).
2) James: confirm Sana Mirza's email so we can add her as a technical stakeholder.
3) Aditya: share the recommended runtime config and a short runbook for load-testing.

I'll queue the DocuSign link and attach here once ready.

—Marissa
